refine.command: 在工作目录写 normals.js（Node，无依赖）：构造一个边长 1 的立方体几何（8 顶点 12 三角面，外观面朝外），导出函数 audit(geometry) 返回 {faces, inwardFaces, facesOutwardRatio}；再写一个 main 打印审计结果。main 必须打印至少一行 JSON（形如 {"faces":12,"inwardFaces":0,"facesOutwardRatio":1}）——判定器按"输出里第一个含这些字段的可解析 JSON"读，不要求它是最后一行。

rounds.code:
const fs = require('fs');

fs.writeFileSync('normals.js', [
"'use strict';",
"",
"function cube(side = 1) {",
"  const h = side / 2;",
"  const positions = [",
"    [-h, -h, -h], [h, -h, -h], [h, h, -h], [-h, h, -h],",
"    [-h, -h,  h], [h, -h,  h], [h, h,  h], [-h, h,  h],",
"  ];",
"  const indices = [",
"    4, 5, 6,  4, 6, 7,   // +z",
"    1, 0, 3,  1, 3, 2,   // -z",
"    5, 1, 2,  5, 2, 6,   // +x",
"    0, 4, 7,  0, 7, 3,   // -x",
"    7, 6, 2,  7, 2, 3,   // +y",
"    0, 1, 5,  0, 5, 4,   // -y",
"  ];",
"  return { positions, indices };",
"}",
"",
"function sub(a, b) { return [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]]; }",
"function cross(a, b) {",
"  return [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];",
"}",
"function dot(a, b) { return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]; }",
"",
"function audit(geometry) {",
"  const { positions, indices } = geometry;",
"  let sx = 0, sy = 0, sz = 0;",
"  for (const p of positions) { sx += p[0]; sy += p[1]; sz += p[2]; }",
"  const n = positions.length || 1;",
"  const center = [sx / n, sy / n, sz / n];",
"  const faces = Math.floor(indices.length / 3);",
"  let inwardFaces = 0;",
"  for (let f = 0; f < faces; f++) {",
"    const a = positions[indices[f * 3]];",
"    const b = positions[indices[f * 3 + 1]];",
"    const c = positions[indices[f * 3 + 2]];",
"    const normal = cross(sub(b, a), sub(c, a));",
"    const fc = [(a[0] + b[0] + c[0]) / 3, (a[1] + b[1] + c[1]) / 3, (a[2] + b[2] + c[2]) / 3];",
"    if (dot(normal, sub(fc, center)) <= 0) inwardFaces++;",
"  }",
"  return {",
"    faces,",
"    inwardFaces,",
"    facesOutwardRatio: faces ? (faces - inwardFaces) / faces : 1,",
"  };",
"}",
"",
"function main() {",
"  const result = audit(cube(1));",
"  console.log(JSON.stringify(result));",
"}",
"",
"module.exports = { cube, audit, main };",
"if (require.main === module) main();",
""
].join('\n'));

const mod = require('./normals.js');
const result = mod.audit(mod.cube(1));
console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
console.log('DONE: normals.js written, audit=', JSON.stringify(result));
